# Procedure schemas
{: .no_toc}

Type-specific details of in-vivo procedures performed on a subject.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- [`proceduretemplate`](/api/modules/proceduretemplate/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Anesthesia, Drug and Fluid Administration

### Analgesic

- type code `Analgesic` · version 2.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/Analgesic/2.0.0.json)

The administration of a pain-relieving agent, such as buprenorphine or meloxicam. Use this for systemic analgesia given before, during, or after a potentially painful intervention.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `volume` | Volume administered | quantity with unit |  | units `mL`, `µL`, `L`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | Total volume of solution delivered to the animal in this administration, not the share of any one component. |
| `route` | Administration route | choice | yes | one of `sc`, `ip`, `im`, `iv`, `oral`, `topical`, `other` | Route of analgesic administration. |
| `indication` | Indication | choice |  | one of `prophylactic`, `therapeutic` | Whether the analgesic was given to prevent expected pain or to treat pain already present. |
| `fatalOutcome` | Fatal outcome | choice |  | one of `not_fatal`, `planned_terminal`, `unintended_death` | Whether the animal died with this procedure, and whether that was intended; record it only on the procedure that actually ended the animal. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "route": "sc",
    "volume": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mL"
    },
    "indication": "prophylactic"
}
```

- Fields hidden by the web form for this type (leave empty): `coordinates`, `coordinates_json`, `target_regions`, `target_regions_atlas`, `equipment`, `equipment_setup`.

### Anesthesia

- type code `Anesthesia` · version 8.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/Anesthesia/8.0.1.json)

The administration of anesthetic agents to induce unconsciousness, analgesia, or sedation. This entry captures anesthetic protocol details and can stand alone or support a larger procedure episode.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `depth` | Anesthetic depth | choice |  | one of `light_sedation`, `moderate_sedation`, `deep_sedation`, `surgical_plane`, `other` | The anesthetic depth reached; deep sedation is not surgical plane. |
| `endOfAnesthesia` | End of anesthesia | text |  |  | Time when anesthesia ended, as HH:MM. |
| `duration` | Total duration | quantity with unit |  | units `h`, `min`, `s`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | Total time the animal spent under anesthesia, across every phase of it. |
| `recoveryTime` | Recovery time | quantity with unit |  | units `h`, `min`, `s`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | Time from end of anesthesia to return of righting reflex or normal activity. |
| `fatalOutcome` | Fatal outcome | choice |  | one of `not_fatal`, `planned_terminal`, `unintended_death` | Whether the animal died with this procedure, and whether that was intended; record it only on the procedure that actually ended the animal. |
| `monitoring` | Monitoring | table of rows |  | format table | What was followed during the anesthetic, how it was assessed, and how often. One row per parameter; an empty table means nothing was monitored. |
| `monitoring[].parameter` | Parameter | choice | yes | one of `anesthetic_depth`, `blood_pressure`, `heart_rate`, `oxygen_saturation`, `respiratory_rate`, `temperature`, `other` | What this row followed — the parameter itself, never the instrument that read it. Anesthetic depth is one of them: choose it, and record the checks used beside it. |
| `monitoring[].method` | Assessment method | multi-select |  | one of `pedal_withdrawal_reflex`, `palpebral_reflex`, `corneal_reflex`, `tail_pinch_reflex`, `visual_observation`, `pulse_oximetry`, `ecg`, `eeg`, `capnography`, `rectal_probe`, `other`; format select2 | How this parameter was assessed; select every check or instrument used. |
| `monitoring[].interval` | Interval | quantity with unit |  | units `h`, `min`, `s`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | How often this parameter was checked. Leave empty for continuous monitoring. |
| `supportiveCare` | Supportive care | table of rows |  | format table | Care given alongside the anesthetic. One row per measure; an empty table means none was given. |
| `supportiveCare[].measure` | Measure | choice | yes | one of `eye_lubricant`, `fluid_therapy`, `heating_pad`, `oxygen_supplementation`, `other` | Which supportive measure was given while the animal was under. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "depth": "light_sedation",
    "endOfAnesthesia": "text"
}
```

- `coordinates_system` accepts Coordinates types: [`Stereotaxic_BregmaBrainSurface`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#stereotaxic-bregma-based-surface-coordinates-with-depth), [`Stereotaxic_LambdaBrainSurface`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#stereotaxic-lambda-based-surface-coordinates-with-depth), [`Landmark_APML_SurfaceDepth`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#landmark-referenced-apml-surface-coordinates-with-depth), [`Spinal_RCML_SurfaceDepth`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#spinal-rcml-surface-coordinates-with-depth), [`CCF_XYZ_Absolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#allen-mouse-ccfv3-xyz-absolute-coordinates), [`WHS_XYZ_Absolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#waxholm-space-rat-brain-atlas-v4-xyz-absolute-coordinates), [`MNI152_XYZ_Absolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#mni152-icbm-2009c-human-xyz-absolute-coordinates), [`NMT_XYZ_Absolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#nimh-macaque-template-v2-xyz-absolute-coordinates), [`MapZebrain_XYZ_Absolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#mapzebrain-larval-zebrafish-xyz-absolute-coordinates), [`JRC2018U_XYZ_Absolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#jrc2018-unisex-fly-brain-xyz-absolute-coordinates), [`BMA_XYZ_Absolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#brainminds-marmoset-atlas-20-xyz-absolute-coordinates), [`Stereotaxic_BregmaAbsolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#stereotaxic-bregma-based-absolute-coordinates), [`Stereotaxic_LambdaAbsolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#stereotaxic-lambda-based-absolute-coordinates), [`Landmark_APMLDV_Absolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#landmark-referenced-apmldv-absolute-coordinates), [`Spinal_RCMLDV_Absolute`](/api/schemas/coordinates/#spinal-rcmldv-absolute-coordinates); other values are refused (400).

### Anti-inflammatory

- type code `AntiInflammatory` · version 2.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/AntiInflammatory/2.0.0.json)

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|

### Drug administration (other)

- type code `DrugAdministration` · version 3.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/DrugAdministration/3.0.0.json)

Use this catch-all only for medication that does not fit a dedicated type, such as a hormone, reversal agent, antidote, or supplement. File by why the drug was given, not by what the drug is: meloxicam for pain is an analgesic, not a drug administration.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `purpose` | Purpose | choice | yes | one of `hormone`, `reversal_antidote`, `supplement`, `other` | What the substance was given for. Use a dedicated procedure type wherever one fits. |

### Fluid therapy

- type code `FluidTherapy` · version 2.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/FluidTherapy/2.0.0.json)

The administration of a physiological solution, such as saline or Ringer's solution, for hydration or volume support. Record the total procedure-level volume and the clinical problem it addressed; state the delivery profile rather than leaving the rate empty to imply a bolus.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|

| `numberOfSites` | Number of sites | integer |  | ≥ 1 | How many separate needle placements or entry points the total volume was divided across. |
| `temperature` | Fluid temperature | quantity with unit |  | units `°C`, `°F`, `K`; default `{"unit": "°C"}` | Temperature of the fluid itself when it was given, not the animal's body temperature. |
| `fluidIndication` | Fluid indication | choice |  | one of `dehydration`, `perioperative_support`, `blood_or_fluid_loss`, `reduced_intake_or_anorexia`, `hypoglycaemia`, `other` | Which clinical problem the fluid was given to address. |
| `fatalOutcome` | Fatal outcome | choice |  | one of `not_fatal`, `planned_terminal`, `unintended_death` | Whether the animal died with this procedure, and whether that was intended; record it only on the procedure that actually ended the animal. |

- type code `LocalAnesthetic` · version 2.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/LocalAnesthetic/2.0.0.json)

A site-directed nerve block, infiltration, or topical application, such as bupivacaine at an incision line. Use Analgesic instead for systemic pain relief.

### Sedative

- type code `Sedative` · version 2.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/Sedative/2.0.1.json)

A sedative or anxiolytic given for non-surgical restraint, imaging, or transport, as distinct from full anesthesia. Record the level the animal actually reached, which may be deeper than the level intended.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `volume` | Volume administered | quantity with unit |  | units `mL`, `µL`, `L`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | Total volume of solution that entered the animal in this event, vehicle included. |
| `rate` | Infusion rate | quantity with unit |  | units `mL/h`, `µL/h`; default `{"unit": "mL/h"}` | Rate the sedative infusion ran at; the delivery profile says whether there was one. |
| `route` | Administration route | choice | yes | one of `sc`, `ip`, `im`, `iv`, `inhaled`, `oral`, `other` | Route of sedative administration. |
| `injectionProfile` | Delivery profile | choice |  | one of `bolus_injection`, `slow_injection`, `continuous_infusion` | Shape the delivery took over time, which an empty rate cannot state. |
| `sedationLevel` | Sedation level | choice |  | one of `light_sedation`, `moderate_sedation`, `deep_sedation`, `surgical_plane`, `other` | The level the animal actually reached; deep sedation is not surgical plane. |
| `duration` | Sedation duration | quantity with unit |  | units `h`, `min`, `s`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | Time from administration of the agent to the end of the sedation. |
| `recoveryTime` | Recovery time | quantity with unit |  | units `h`, `min`, `s`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | Time from the end of the sedation until the animal rights itself and moves normally. |
| `fatalOutcome` | Fatal outcome | choice |  | one of `not_fatal`, `planned_terminal`, `unintended_death` | Whether the animal died with this procedure, and whether that was intended; record it only on the procedure that actually ended the animal. |
| `monitoring` | Monitoring | table of rows |  | format table | What was followed while the animal was sedated, how, and how often. One row per parameter; an empty table means nothing was monitored. |
| `monitoring[].parameter` | Parameter | choice | yes | one of `anesthetic_depth`, `blood_pressure`, `heart_rate`, `oxygen_saturation`, `respiratory_rate`, `temperature`, `other` | What this row followed — the parameter itself, never the instrument that read it. Anesthetic depth covers the sedation level. |
| `monitoring[].method` | Assessment method | multi-select |  | one of `pedal_withdrawal_reflex`, `palpebral_reflex`, `corneal_reflex`, `tail_pinch_reflex`, `visual_observation`, `pulse_oximetry`, `ecg`, `eeg`, `capnography`, `rectal_probe`, `other`; format select2 | How this parameter was assessed; select every check or instrument used. |
| `monitoring[].interval` | Interval | quantity with unit |  | units `h`, `min`, `s`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | How often this parameter was checked. Leave empty for continuous monitoring. |
| `supportiveCare` | Supportive care | table of rows |  | format table | Care given alongside the sedation. One row per measure; an empty table means none was given. |
| `supportiveCare[].measure` | Measure | choice | yes | one of `eye_lubricant`, `fluid_therapy`, `heating_pad`, `oxygen_supplementation`, `other` | Which supportive measure was given while the animal was sedated. |

```json
    "volume": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mL"
    },
    "rate": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "mL/h"
    }
}
```

### Craniotomy

- type code `Craniotomy` · version 2.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/Craniotomy/2.0.1.json)

### ECoG implant (Electrocorticography)

- type code `EcogImplant` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/EcogImplant/1.0.1.json)

Placement of a flexible grid or strip array of contacts on the brain surface, above or beneath the dura, or on thinned skull, to record without penetrating the tissue. The array itself is recorded as the required ECoG array material row, sourced from your ECoG array stock or catalog.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `placementLayer` | Placement layer | choice |  | one of `epidural`, `subdural`, `epicranial` | Which tissue layer the array was laid on: the dura, the brain surface after opening the dura, or the bone. |
| `duraHandling` | Dura handling | choice |  | one of `left_intact`, `punctured`, `incised`, `excised` | How the dura was handled at the opening before the array was laid down; a strip slid under the bone edge over intact dura counts as left intact. |
| `skullPreparation` | Skull preparation | multi-select |  | one of `cleaned`, `periosteum_removed`, `roughened`, `dried`, `etched`, `primed`, `none`; format select2 | How the skull was prepared before attachment; select every step that was carried out. |
| `arrayAdhesion` | Array adhesion | choice |  | one of `none`, `tissue_adhesive`, `cement_at_margin`, `sutured_to_dura`, `other` | How the array itself was held on the surface; how the connector was anchored goes under fixation method. |
| `groundPlacement` | Ground placement | choice |  | one of `cerebellum`, `frontal_bone`, `parietal_bone`, `neck_muscle`, `subcutaneous`, `none`, `other` | Where the ground screw or wire was placed on the animal in this surgery. |
| `referencePlacement` | Reference placement | choice |  | one of `cerebellum`, `frontal_bone`, `parietal_bone`, `neck_muscle`, `subcutaneous`, `on_array`, `none`, `other` | Where the reference was placed in this surgery; on the array means a dedicated contact of the array itself. |
| `groundReferenceTied` | Ground and reference tied | yes/no |  |  | Check this if the ground and the reference were joined together on the animal. |
| `fixationMethod` | Fixation method | multi-select |  | one of `dental_cement`, `acrylic`, `uv_cured_resin`, `super_glue`, `epoxy`, `screws`, `headcap`, `custom_holder`, `none`, `other`; format select2 | How the skull-borne assembly (connector and ribbon root) was held to the skull; select every method that contributed. |
| `fatalOutcome` | Fatal outcome | choice |  | one of `not_fatal`, `planned_terminal`, `unintended_death` | Whether the animal died with this procedure, and whether that was intended; record it only on the procedure that actually ended the animal. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "placementLayer": "epidural",
    "duraHandling": "left_intact"
}
```

- type code `EegImplant` · version 4.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/EegImplant/4.0.0.json)

Placement of electrodes on or beneath the skull to record large-scale brain electrical activity.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `wireCount` | Wire count | integer | yes | ≥ 1; default `1` | Number of electrodes used for EEG recording. |

### EMG implant (Electromyography)

- type code `EmgImplant` · version 3.1.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/EmgImplant/3.1.0.json)

Placement of electrodes in or on muscles to record muscle electrical activity.

| `fatalOutcome` | Fatal outcome | choice |  | one of `not_fatal`, `planned_terminal`, `unintended_death` | Whether the animal died with this procedure, and whether that was intended; record it only on the procedure that actually ended the animal. |

- type code `GenericImplant` · version 2.1.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/GenericImplant/2.1.0.json)

Use this only when an implantation action does not fit any specific implant type above. Describe the implanted item and purpose clearly in the structured details and notes.

| `powerSource` | Power source | choice |  | one of `battery`, `inductive`, `wired`, `passive`, `none`, `other` | How the implant is powered, if relevant. |
| `sterilizationMethod` | Sterilization method | choice |  | one of `autoclave`, `ethylene_oxide`, `alcohol`, `gamma_irradiation`, `none` | Sterilization technique used prior to implantation. |
| `fatalOutcome` | Fatal outcome | choice |  | one of `not_fatal`, `planned_terminal`, `unintended_death` | Whether the animal died with this procedure, and whether that was intended; record it only on the procedure that actually ended the animal. |

| `preservationMethod` | Preservation method | choice |  | one of `fresh`, `ethanol`, `rnalater`, `paraformaldehyde_fixation`, `formalin_fixation`, `flash_freezing`, `liquid_nitrogen`, `dry_ice`, `other` | Method used to preserve the collected tissue. |

### Brain perfusion fixation

- type code `PerfusionFixation` · version 3.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Procedure/PerfusionFixation/3.0.1.json)

Perfusion of fixative through the circulatory system to preserve the brain and other tissues. This remains a Procedure because it is performed on the subject.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `route` | Vascular access route | choice |  | one of `intracardiac`, `carotid`, `intra_aortic`, `intracranial`, `other` | Where the perfusate entered the circulation. |
| `perfusionScope` | Perfusion scope | choice |  | one of `whole_body`, `head_only`, `other` | How far the perfusate was carried through the animal. |
| `perfusionDrive` | Perfusion drive | choice |  | one of `gravity_feed`, `peristaltic_pump`, `syringe_pump`, `pressurized_line`, `manual_syringe`, `other` | What pushed the perfusate through the circulation. |
| `pressure` | Perfusion pressure | quantity with unit |  | units `mmHg`, `cmH₂O`, `kPa`; default `{"unit": "mmHg"}` | Pressure the perfusate was delivered at, read from the regulator or the height of the reservoir. |
| `heartBeatingAtStart` | Heart beating at start | yes/no |  |  | Check this if the heart was still beating when the perfusate first entered the circulation. |
| `phases` | Perfusion phases | table of rows |  | format table | Each phase of the perfusion, one row per phase, in the order they were delivered. The wash and the fixative make different claims about volume, rate, duration, and temperature, so each states its own. |
| `phases[].phase` | Phase | choice | yes | one of `wash`, `fixative`, `other` | What this row delivered: the wash that clears blood from the circulation (a rinse and a flush are the same step under one name), the fixative that follows it, or another step. |
| `phases[].volume` | Volume | quantity with unit |  | units `L`, `mL`, `µL`, `nL`, `pL`; default `{"unit": "mL"}` | Volume delivered in this phase, as it was actually run rather than as planned. |
| `phases[].flowRate` | Rate | quantity with unit |  | units `L/min`, `mL/min`, `µL/min`; default `{"unit": "mL/min"}` | Rate at which this phase's solution moved through the circulation. |
| `phases[].duration` | Duration | quantity with unit |  | units `h`, `min`, `s`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | How long this phase ran. Fixative contact time is what over- and under-fixation are compared on, and it is normally not the same as the wash duration. |
| `phases[].temperature` | Temperature | quantity with unit |  | units `°C`; default `{"unit": "°C"}` | Temperature of the solution delivered in this phase. |
| `completionSigns` | Signs of completion | multi-select |  | one of `liver_blanching`, `clear_effluent`, `fixation_tremor`, `tissue_rigidity`, `pale_brain`; format select2 | Which conventional signs that the perfusion was working were actually seen. |
| `failureMode` | Failure modes | multi-select |  | one of `clotting`, `cannula_misplaced`, `atrium_not_opened`, `oedema`, `circuit_leak`, `air_embolism`, `residual_blood`, `other`; format select2 | What went wrong, if anything; tick every fault that applied. Leave empty if nothing went wrong. |
| `confirmationOfDeath` | Confirmation of death | multi-select |  | one of `absence_of_heartbeat`, `absence_of_breathing`, `absence_of_reflexes`, `fixed_dilated_pupils`, `loss_of_corneal_reflex`, `other`; format select2 | How death was verified at the end of the perfusion. Tick every check that was made; verification normally combines more than one. |
| `fatalOutcome` | Fatal outcome | choice |  | one of `not_fatal`, `planned_terminal`, `unintended_death` | Whether the animal died with this procedure, and whether that was intended; record it only on the procedure that actually ended the animal. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "route": "intracardiac",
    "perfusionScope": "whole_body"
}
```
